title: Capstone: Ship shipit to Kubernetes
summary: Deploy the full shipit stack (API, web, Postgres, Redis) to a multi-node kind cluster with your own Helm chart, Gateway API routing with TLS, StatefulSet storage, probes, autoscaling, disruption budgets, NetworkPolicies, RBAC and Pod Security, optionally via Argo CD, then break it on purpose in a game day.
objectives: Turn a multi-service application into a single, well-structured Helm chart
Run Postgres as a StatefulSet with a PersistentVolumeClaim and prove data survives pod loss
Expose the app over HTTPS with Gateway API (Envoy Gateway), including path rewriting and an HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect
Make the app resilient: probes, resources, HPA, PDB, topology spread, graceful shutdown
Lock it down: restricted Pod Security, least-privilege ServiceAccounts, default-deny NetworkPolicies
Optionally deliver it with Argo CD
Run a game day, record what broke and what you would change
